items.title: CritICL: Inference-Time Weak-to-Strong Generalization from Small Language Model Failure Modes
items.description: Recent advances in inference-time scaling have significantly improved the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs). However, these methods typically rely on repeated generation or external verification. To address this limitation, we introduce CritICL, a novel inference-time framework that improves reasoning while maintaining high efficiency.
